ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(RFP__c), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard_Opportunity", OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, "New Business - New Customer"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "New Business - Cross-Sell") ), ISCHANGED(StageName), CASE( TEXT(StageName), "Lead Qualification", 1, "Discovery", 2, "SE Technical Review", 3, "Proposal", 4, "RFP", 5, "Award", 6, "Scoping", 7, "Contract", 8, "Closed Won", 9, 0 ) > 1, OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(LeadSource)), ISBLANK(NextStep) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Complete Lead Qualification before advancing: Lead Source, and Next Step are required.
